name: Leon
description: Self-hosted personal AI assistant that runs locally and is being rebuilt around an agentic core in its 2.0 developer preview.
whatItDoes: Acts as a personal assistant running on the user's own machine, reachable through a local web app. The 2.0 developer preview is on the develop branch, while master holds the older, more stable version.
howItWorks: A Node.js core is installed with pnpm and serves the app on localhost:5366. The maintainer notes that the documentation site still describes the legacy architecture.
